# Suede Universe Map

> Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients. The Suede Universe Map is the plain-English, live-verified map of every public Suede AI site, app and tool: what each is for, how they connect, and which link to click.

Founder: Jason Colapietro is an engineer, author, and the founder and CEO of Suede AI. He has 54 pull requests merged across 46 open-source repositories he does not maintain, including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage and the Polkadot SDK; he has written five books on Amazon Kindle, including The Claude Code Bible and Codex in Production; and he has shipped 9 iOS apps under his own Apple developer account. He publishes under the pen name Johnny Suede. His founder page, the main record, is https://suedeai.ai/founder.

## Entity

Suede AI’s official sites are suedeai.ai, suedeai.org and their subdomains. It was founded in 2024 by Jason Colapietro.

- Organization: Suede AI, also known as Suede Labs. Canonical identity: https://suedeai.ai/#organization
- Founder: Jason Colapietro. Canonical identity: https://suedeai.ai/founder#person
- Official identity pages: [Jason Colapietro](https://jasoncolapietro.com) and [Johnny Suede](https://johnnysuede.com).

The map reads top to bottom as a public operating graph: Jason Colapietro (the founder), JC Investment Group LLC (an active Florida LLC whose public filing lists Jason as manager), Suede AI (the agentic platform company), and the publicly connected tools and sites below. The JC Investment Group LLC filing is dated June 3, 2019 under Florida document L19000146068.

Claim boundary: this public operating map documents public pages, links, filings, and stated roles. It does not establish legal title, parent/subsidiary relationships, or ownership percentages.

## What Suede AI does, in order

1. [Suede AI Agent Studio](https://agents.suedeai.ai): agent platforms for your business. Build agents for the work that repeats, watch every run, publish an agent as a paid endpoint.
2. [White-label agent platforms](https://suedeai.ai/white-label): Suede builds and runs an agent platform under an agency's brand for its clients. Scoped per engagement.
3. [Managed AI agents](https://suedeai.ai/managed-ai-agents) and [AI operations](https://suedeai.ai/ai-operations): Suede builds, runs and tunes agents for a business; every run is visible in Agent Studio.
4. [Forward-deployed engineering](https://suedeai.ai/forward-deployed-engineer) and [fractional Chief AI Officer](https://suedeai.ai/fractional-chief-ai-officer) work, founder-led.
5. [Suede AI SEO](https://seo.suedeai.ai): the GEO, AEO and SEO practice for AI search visibility.
6. [Music and creator software](https://suedeai.ai/music): a separate product line.

## Map

- [The Suede Universe Map](https://map.suedeai.ai/): Public operating graph from founder to entity to company to every publicly connected product, plus a "which link do I click" router table.

- [Press kit](https://map.suedeai.ai/press/): Boilerplate, fact sheet, founder bio and brand assets.
- [Full text of the map and press kit](https://map.suedeai.ai/llms-full.txt): every card, router row and FAQ answer as plain Markdown.

## Core Suede properties

- [Suede AI](https://suedeai.ai): The company site: agent platforms, white-label agent platforms and managed agents.
- [Founder page](https://suedeai.ai/founder): Jason Colapietro, founder and CEO of Suede AI, who publishes under the pen name Johnny Suede. The main record of his work.
- [suedeai.org](https://suedeai.org): Suede AI's research and investor site.

## Accomplishments

54 merged pull requests. 46 external repositories.
As of September 2026, the public record shows 54 pull requests merged across 46 external repositories Jason does not maintain: 33 substantive code or documentation contributions and 21 accepted listings of Jason-owned work. Maintainers have merged contributions into projects including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage, the Polkadot SDK, Hardhat, the x402 Foundation and zeroclaw. A separate Linux kernel USB/IP patch is at Public upstream v7 and under review; it is not counted. Adobe React Spectrum #10426 was merged and later replaced by #10491, so it is recorded as a historical contribution, not a currently shipped API.
Complete upstream record: https://suedeai.ai/founder#open-source-work
Open-source evidence on Suede AI SEO: https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence#open-source
Machine-readable merged-PR record: https://suedeai.ai/open-source-contributions.json
Jest #16296: https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/16296
Adobe React Spectrum #10426: https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10426
Adobe React Spectrum #10491 (replacement): https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10491
Every merged PR outside Jason’s own repositories, on GitHub: https://github.com/search?q=is%3Apr+author%3AJasonColapietro+author%3ASuede-AI+is%3Amerged+-user%3AJasonColapietro+-user%3ASuede-AI&type=pullrequests

A feature in Adobe’s design system, and fixes in Backstage, Hardhat, zeroclaw, and the Polkadot SDK
The contributions to lead with: a public useShowFocusIndicator hook accepted into Adobe React Spectrum by a core maintainer; a catalog-graph fix in Backstage, the CNCF developer-portal framework; removal of the retired Holesky chain descriptor from Hardhat, merged by a project lead; a daemon socket-ownership fix in the zeroclaw runtime, 767 lines of Rust across two crates; an RPC capacity-release fix in the Polkadot SDK; and two Jest fixes, one isolating virtual mock module IDs and one tolerating a transient watcher error.

More than 30 sites, and a published app family
Jason builds and operates the Suede estate: AI agent platforms first (Suede AI Agent Studio and Agentix), the Suede AI SEO practice and Suede Scan, developer infrastructure, and, as a separate product line, music and creator software such as Suede AI Studio, Suede AI Distro, Strumly, Suede Muse, Suede Social and Suede DNA. Agent flows that ship as x402 endpoints settling in USDC on Base
Suede AI Agent Studio lets a builder draw an agent as a node graph and launch it as an x402 pay-per-call endpoint settling in USDC on Base, with Agentix tracking per-call earnings. The work implements the x402 protocol and ERC-8004 and includes a merged fix in the x402 Foundation’s own repository. It builds on those standards as an implementer, not a standards author.
Suede AI Agent Studio: https://agents.suedeai.ai
Agentix: https://agentix.suedeai.ai
x402-foundation/x402 #3180: https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/3180
